title: Marvel Daredevil Funko Pop! Comic Book Cover with Case  - Target Exclusive
descriptionText:
Box is damaged. 

The Marvel Daredevil Funko Pop! Comic Book Cover with Case is a unique collectible figure featuring the popular character Daredevil from the Marvel franchise. This Target Exclusive item is part of the Pop! Comic Book Cover with Case series, adding a special touch to any comic book or superhero collection. The vinyl figure comes in a 55th box number and is a must-have for fans of comics and comic book covers, highlighting the iconic artwork and designs from the Marvel universe.
